Lina Pérez: Heads up — partners sent updated pricing for marketplace SKUs. Need to reconcile reserved vs ephemeral inputs for cost model. Key Qs: (1) do marketplace listings guarantee commit windows? (2) how are spot eviction rates encoded in CSV? (3) billing lag assumptions? Can people +finance weigh in? :eyes:

Mike Chen: they gave two feeds — commit windows in days and an 'eviction_prob' column. sample: ```sku,commit_days,eviction_prob,price_per_hour
A100-80GB,30,0.03,4.5
H100-80GB,365,0.001,9.0
```

Raj Patel: important — marketplace listing doesn't imply reserve; it's just availability. For reserved offers they include a 'reserved_discount' and 'min_commit' fields. Also watch for listing tiering: short-tenor commits sometimes priced higher per-hour but with lower overage.

Samantha Wong: finance note — we historically model billing lag as 7 days for marketplace, but partners warned of monthly reconciliation windows for credits. I'd set billing_lag = 14 days for conservative.

Mike Chen: adding operational note — eviction_prob is correlated with region. CSV has region suffix, e.g., `A100-80GB.us-east-1`. Our parser needs to aggregate by region or we'll under/over estimate.

Lina Pérez: good catch — can someone paste a real sample from the feed (sanitized)? We need to validate our ingestion mapping.

OpsBot: vendor-feed-uploader processed file vendor-zenith-2026-03.csv (rows: 462) — status: uploaded, schema: v2.3

Mike Chen: pasted snippet (sanitized): ```sku,region,commit_days,eviction_prob,price_per_hour,reserved_discount,min_commit
A100-80GB,us-east-1,30,0.045,4.75,0.25,100
A100-80GB,eu-west-1,30,0.07,5.1,0.2,80
H100-80GB,us-east-1,365,0.002,9.5,0.35,10
```

Raj Patel: question — for cost-model, should we map reserved_discount to effective hourly cost as price_per_hour*(1-reserved_discount) but only after min_commit hours used? Also how to model partial-month usage? Thoughts.

Samantha Wong: yes to discount formula. For min_commit modeling — assume linear amortization across commit_days, and treat failure to hit commit as penalty fee equal to 50% of remaining commit value (conservative).

Lina Pérez: action items: (1) Mike to update ingest to handle regionized eviction_prob and reserved_discount (PR by EOD), (2) Finance (Samantha) to confirm billing_lag and penalty assumptions in spreadsheet, (3) Raj to run sensitivity with +/-20% eviction rates. I'll loop in legal if penalty modeling affects contract language. Thanks :thumbsup:
